title: Google Play Billing Library 7 is past its deprecation deadline
summary: The Google Play Billing Library version deprecation page states that all versions have a two-year deprecation cycle. Its support timeline table lists version 7 with a new app and update deadline of August 31, 2026 and an extension deadline of November 1, 2026.

sources.title: Google Play Billing Library version deprecation — support timeline

constraints: Keep every module, version catalog entry, and BOM override on one Play Billing Library major that Google Play still accepts for new apps and updates.

Major upgrades of com.android.billingclient:billing can require BillingClient API changes; read the Play Billing Library migration guide for the jump from the reported major to the replacement before shipping.

steps.title: Raise the Play Billing Library dependency
steps.instructions: Change the reported com.android.billingclient:billing version to Google Play Billing Library 8.x or 9.x (see the replacement) in the build.gradle(.kts) dependency (or the version catalog key that supplies it).

steps.title: Align other Play Billing declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other Gradle module, libs.versions.toml entry, and dependency-management block that still pins the old major, and adjust BillingClient call sites the migration guide names for that jump.

verification.purpose: Build a debug APK with the raised Play Billing Library major.
Confirm the resolved Play Billing Library major matches the intended replacement.
